nolith_perms_revision_note: Reduced 500->50: WGCNA 1.74 modulePreservation observed-preservation-values step empirically scales with nPermutations (~6460s at nPerm=500 vs ~80s at nPerm=50 on this machine). 500 nolith perms alone would require >12900s (ref-adj 6460s + 500x12.8s=6400s), exceeding the session cap before any lith draws run. Reduced to 50 to match lith-draw precision and fit within the ~18000s session window. Change made before any nolith result was computed; pre-specification integrity maintained.
